claim_definitions.statement: SP-003 design contract, Goal, Stage Plan and execution entries are durably recorded.
A bounded implementation candidate has passed the declared clean-room and independent validation evidence.
The full SP-003 completion rule is satisfied for the bounded public distribution architecture.
The bm-sge-governance GitHub repository has been externally updated and released.

mission: 在不建立双向真源的前提下，把私有 sge-governance-skill 设计并演进为唯一 canonical development source，把公开 bm-sge-governance 设计为 exact-allowlist、可重算、可审计的 deterministic public projection/distribution repo，并为维护者与终端用户提供分离且可验证的工作路径。

must_have_ledger.evidence: 双仓 KB contract、Loop Goal、Scope/Authority coverage matrix
must_have_ledger.requirement: 冻结私有 canonical source、公开 projection 与禁止双向真源的 source-of-truth contract。

must_have_ledger.evidence: public boundary contract、allowlist/d deny cases、clean-room export evidence
must_have_ledger.requirement: 冻结 bm-sge-governance 的 exact-allowlist public content boundary 与 default-deny/private residue 排除面。

must_have_ledger.evidence: maintainer workflow、ERBE cases、independent validation 与 final diff
must_have_ledger.requirement: 定义 deterministic export→diff→validation→public repo update 流程及每一步的 authority、输入输出和禁止折叠。
定义 source revision、manifest revision、candidate identity、projection commit、tag/release identity 的互不替代关系。
定义公开仓 clone 后的 end-user install 路径：默认 source=current public repo，只需 target，--source 仅作高级/测试入口。
定义 upgrade、backup、install record、恢复/卸载的 provenance 与 target authority 保留规则。
物理和合同上分离 maintainer surface 与 end-user surface，禁止用户承担 export/allowlist/release 内部知识。
定义 public repo 外部 PR 的 review、回流 canonical、重新 export/validation 的单向贡献路径。

must_have_ledger.evidence: release governance contract、permission matrix、authorization record template
must_have_ledger.requirement: 冻结 GitHub push/tag/release 权限边界、CI 默认不自动发布与逐次人类授权要求。
以 clean-room、维护者回归、终端用户 UAT 和 independent validation 验证双仓架构的关键路径与负例。
保持 candidate、validated、approved、published、production-ready、Git mutation 等状态轴分离。

must_have_ledger.evidence: SP-003 OPCM、中文 closeout、独立最终对账与 Dashboard 状态
must_have_ledger.requirement: 完成逐项 Original Plan Coverage Matrix、Scope Delta、中文 closeout、final validation 与 post-closeout reconciliation。

boundary.direction: private canonical source -> clean staging -> deterministic public projection
boundary.external_side_effects: GitHub create/push/tag/release remain separately authorized and are outside this design landing
boundary.private_source: sge-governance-skill is the only development source
boundary.public_projection: bm-sge-governance is a one-way projection/distribution repository

closeout.forbidden: public repo created, published, production-ready or GitHub mutation completed based only on this design
closeout.must_report: slice verdict, Session/Goal terminal state, remaining must-haves, Scope Delta, next Session, human decision state

contribution: public PR is input, not canonical truth
maintainer reviews and ports/merges into private source
end_user_surface: advanced --source only for explicit test or alternate-source diagnostics

implementation_ladder.outcome: 冻结双仓 source-of-truth、public content boundary、maintainer/end-user surface 与负例合同
实现或修订维护者 fresh-root exact-allowlist export、residue scan、tree diff 与 projection manifest
实现公开仓 clone/install/doctor/upgrade/backup/install-record/recoverable-uninstall 用户路径
冻结 revision/candidate/projection/tag/release identity 与 GitHub permission/authorization matrix
实现并验证 external PR -> private canonical -> re-export -> independent validation 回流流程
完成 clean-room maintainer/end-user UAT、ERBE RED/GREEN 与独立 Validation/Semantic Review
完成 OPCM、中文 closeout、release decision boundary 与 post-closeout reconciliation

maintainer_surface: source repository and private execution memory
public repository update and release authorization
sections.minimum_safe_slice: S-016 freezes the dual-repository contract, public content boundary, identity axes and negative cases before any implementation or remote action.

public_surface.allow: allowlisted generic Skill, public docs/KB/examples/tests/tools and public metadata only
public_surface.deny: Dashboard, Sessions, Stage Plans, Agent Logs, closeouts, private provenance, local reports, dirty worktree, absolute paths, credentials and unknown files
public_surface.overlay: target-project AGENTS/Dashboard/Goal/Session/profile remain owned by the user project

read_manifest: SP-002 Loop Goal/Goal Patch/Stage Plan/OPCM/Validation/Release Decision Packet
sections.scope_delta: No approved Scope Delta at design landing. Any deletion, authority change, release widening or conversion of public projection into a second source requires a new Goal Patch and human approval.
session_dag: S-022 is the only Goal closure session; any earlier Done closes only its bounded scope
